title: SMOK Novo 5 Replacement Pods 0.7ohm - 3 Pack
description: These replacement pods for the Smok Novo 5 pod kit are designed to provide a smooth and satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experience, with a comfortable, ergonomic mouthpiece that makes them supremely enjoyable to use over long vaping sessions. Each pod has a 2ml e-liquid capacity and comes with a fixed-coil that has a resistance of 0.7ohm, ideal for MTL vaping. The Smok Novo 5 Replacement Pods are suitable for use with 50/50, high-PG, and nicotine salts e-liquids, giving you plenty of options when it comes to choosing your favourite juice. With their convenient and easy-to-use design, these pods are perfect for vapers who want a hassle-free vaping experience. Overall, the Smok Novo 5 Replacement Pods 0.7ohm 3 pack is an excellent choice if you need replacement pods for your Smok Novo 5 pod kit. With their comfortable mouthpiece, fixed-coil design, and compatibility with a wide range of e-liquids, these pods are sure to provide a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
